{{#SQuote:|text="Specialized Relay (Nexus) parasites such as Dispatchers can form nests that accelerate growth and expansion for the hive. These sites rapidly turn surrounded terrain into active and foggy infestation zones. A [[Fog Nullifier]] can be used to remove said fog."|speaker=[[Compendium|The Compendium]]|receiver=|attribution=|source=|id=no|template=}}

'''Nests''' are structures generated by chance when a [[Dispatcher (Disambiguation)|Dispatcher]], [[Rooter (Disambiguation)|Rooter]], or [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Beckon]] evolves from Stage I to Stage II. The Nest appears instantly around it, removing any blocks and replacing them with the corresponding blocks depending on which [[:Category:Nexus_Parasites|Nexus]] parasite created it. Nests are generated by code, so each instance is unique whilst following a pattern described by formulas, by extension of this, any generated Compressed Arteries or Flesh Chunks have a very slim chance to become either [[Dead Blood]], [[Parasitic Growth Block|Loot Blocks]], or be replaced by air altogether. 

==''Beckon Nests''==
{{Node Info
|title1=Beckon Nest
|image1=Beckon Nest Example.png
|caption1=An example of two Beckon Nests.}}
Beckon Nests are usually made up of small structures composed of Infested Dirt, Infested Stone, and Compressed Hivestone, and leaking [[Dead Blood]] that allows summoned parasites to heal fully in seconds. Rooters typically spawn in and around this Dead Blood, allowing for near infinite damage soaking were they to spawn inside, as its poison damage per tick turns into direct healing.

Unlike the other two Nest types, Beckon Nests are much smaller, have no fog, and are not comprised of fleshy blocks.








==''Dispatcher Nests''==
{{Node Info
|title1=Dispatcher Nest
|image1=Dispatcher Nest Example.png
|caption1=An example of a Dispatcher Nest, with a [[Parasitic Growth Block|Benign Growth]] on the right, a [[Parasitic Growth Block|Malignant Growth]] on the top, and a [[Parasitic Growth Block|Metastatic Mass]] on the left.}}
Dispatcher Nests are comprised of Compressed Arteries, Flesh Chunks, [[Dead Blood]], [[Parasitic Growth Block|Loot Blocks]], and Fog all throughout the inside.

Rooters typically spawn outside or inside the Dispatcher Nests as support. Dead Blood, if touched, damages the player every tick and inflicts stacking [[Viral]]. The Fog serves as a hindering mechanism and can be removed with a Fog Nullifier or by killing the Dispatcher.

Dispatcher Nests contain Malignant/Benign Growths or Metastatic Masses with useful loot. Dispatcher Nests usually generate four to six growths. If a player takes an item out of one, they will be afflicted with [[Viral]] and [[Corrosion]] for an increasing effect duration depending on how many slots within the growth are empty. All of them emit a dim light to make locating them easier. The loot inside can be:

===''[[Parasitic Growth Block|Benign Growths]]''===
Benign Growths are bright red blocks with a vortex-like hole in the center. They are the most common loot block, with usually four to five per structure, and contain simpler, more primitive drops, which are:
* [[Infected Flesh]]
* [[Strange Bone|Strange Bones]]
----
===''[[Parasitic Growth Block|Malignant Growths]]''===
Malignant Growths resemble Benign Growths with an eye-like object resting in the vortex. They are rarer, with usually one to three per structure if they do generate at all, containing more various and higher-level drops, which are:
* [[Infected Flesh]]
* [[Strange Bone|Strange Bones]]
* [[Yelloweye Bone|Yelloweye Bones]]
* [[Bolster Husk|Bolster Husks]]
* [[Longarms Armor Fragment|Longarms Armor Fragments]]
* [[Devourer Tentacle|Devourer Tentacles]]
* [[Reeker Fang|Reeker Fangs]]
* [[Arachnida Claw|Arachnida Claws]]
* [[Manducater Orb|Manducater Orbs]]
* [[Summoner Core|Summoner Cores]]
----
===''[[Parasitic Growth Block|Metastatic Masses]]''===
Metastatic Masses appear the same as Benign Growths but have large green spheres protruding from the vortex. They are the rarest, seldom appearing with only one to two per structure, containing difficult-to-obtain and the highest tier drops, which are:
* [[Noxious Brain|Noxious Brains]]
* [[Toxic Lung|Toxic Lungs]]
* [[Twisted Spinal Signal|Twisted Spinal Signals]]
* [[Beckon Membrane|Beckon Membranes]]
* [[Dispatcher Membrane|Dispatcher Membranes]]

==''Rooter Nests''==
{{Node Info
|title1=Rooter Nest
|image1=Rooter Nest Example.png
|caption1=An example of a Rooter Nest.}}

These Nests are comprised of Assimilated Fungus, Compressed Arteries, and have Fog expanding upward outside of the main structure. There may be [[Parasitic Growth Block|Loot Blocks]] under the main structure, but these are usually only Benign Growths and contain less valuable loot than a Dispatcher Nest.

Rooter Nests provide a [[Beckon (Disambiguation)|Beckon]] infestation growth buff.

The Fog serves as a hindering mechanism for the player and may be removed with a Fog Nullifier or by killing its Rooter.



==''Trivia''== 
*Nests were teased back in 1.9's config file, alongside [[Hive|Hives]].
*Nests are labeled '''Nexus Protection''' in the files.
